name: CYBERSECEVAL 3
description: CYBERSECEVAL 3 is a suite of security benchmarks designed to empirically measure cybersecurity risks and capabilities of large language models (LLMs). It assesses 8 different risks across two broad categories: risks to third parties and risks to application developers and end users, including new areas focused on offensive security capabilities.
reputation: A widely cited cybersecurity benchmark suite for evaluating LLM risk and offensive-security capabilities.
notes: Focuses on measuring cybersecurity risks and offensive security capabilities of LLMs; applied to Llama 3 and other state-of-the-art models.
